$Comment: Sawyer Marn as Woodcutting's trainer, at the second counter of the gathering stall in MMO Skill Tree's Adventurers' Hall, beside Forager Bram (Custom anchor, Provider ziggfreedcommon:hub, so he follows the hall to any lot). A child of the MMO's Mmo_Trainer, which says how every trainer works: everything not written here (the lifecycle, the trainer page's parts, the reach) comes from there. Identity.Role is his own role, so this is the same Marn who stands on the temple's landing (Mmo_Sawyer_Temple.json) handing out the Sawmill quests: his trainer page's Quests part lists them too. Pressing F opens his trainer conversation (Dialogues/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Trainer_Sawyer.json), whose Train answer opens his trainer page. He teaches every lesson whose Where names Mmo_Trainer_Sawyer (this pack's TrackPicks/MMOSkillTree/Stations files name him on Woodcutting's abilities, beside Bram and the Skill Trainer). Requires keeps him away, and teaching nothing, while the stations feature is off or the hall does not stand (ziggfreedcommon:hub_district Min 1; written here because a child would otherwise take the Skill Trainer's stand-in rule). Switch him off on the NPC Placements screen (/zigadmin) and his lessons stay with Bram.
Name: Mmo_Trainer_Sawyer
